About this Event

Bottoms Up! Yoga & Brew is flowing at BrewDog Cleveland for all of 2026! Join us for an all-levels class led by a great, local instructor in BrewDog's amazing space. When the weather cooperates, we'll be flowing out on the lawn so plan accordingly. Once it gets too chilly and the weather heads to winter, we'll be flowing inside. Afterwards, let's hang out and sip on a complimentary brew (they even have great NA options!) and enjoy the weekend together.
